_provenance: LLM-built at BUILD TIME by the exp_dev agent (Claude Opus) from general world knowledge, SCALED to cover the readers actual working vocabulary (frequency-selected top-110 verb lemmas x top-3 attested content-noun patients each from the McGuffey second+fourth reader corpus, UNION the 117-pair tiny 29471 table). Rated from a shuffled UNLABELED pair list; agent never saw gold-vs-distractor pairing at rating time. KB-VETTED: every entry checked against a VerbNet+WordNet auditor (see audit_table() in exp_pivot_scaled_seed_knowledge_table_v1.py) that flags CONTRADICTION (not absence) with the ontologys own checkable selectional signal. Runtime = glass-box dict lookup, NO LLM at inference.
key_note: primary key = verb_lemma|noun_lemma (matches THIN/TINY lookup convention); each record ALSO carries verb_concept_id/noun_concept_id (stable WordNet-synset or verbnet-classid identity) for future non-string (e.g. vision) grounding to bind onto without re-keying.
